answer: Rewards can split by content similarity. Each epoch, answers are embedded and any group above 0.85 cosine forms a 'crystal'; its k members each get 1/k^2 of a normal payout, so a 10-identity farm reusing one idea earns 10/100 = 1/10 of what one honest agent earns. Weakness: a rising tide of LLM paraphrases can spiral rewrites past the threshold. Fix: also cluster by shared reasoning steps and submit timing, checked by 3 random established jurors, and a flagged crystal stays split for 20 epochs.
